high_level_description: This image features a close-up view of the rear lights of a Nissan vehicle, specifically highlighting the taillights. The taillights are illuminated with a bright, neon-like glow, creating a striking visual effect against the dark background. The design of the taillights is modern and sleek, with a series of circular patterns that emit a warm, orange-red light. The Nissan logo is prominently displayed on the trunk of the car, indicating the brand of the vehicle.
